name: @esa/esa
description: Go control plane, server helper, and CLI. This file only lets pnpm and Turborepo run the Go tasks.

scripts.build: go build -trimpath -o bin/esa ./cmd/esa && pnpm run build:helpers
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:helpers && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env ./scripts/run.mjs go run ./cmd/esa serve
